title: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets
abstract: arXiv:2605.07386v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: \emph{Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets (CONES)} is considered where the objective function \(f\) remains fixed but the feasible region evolves over time as a nested sequence \(S_1 \supseteq S_2 \supseteq \cdots \supseteq S_T\). The goal of an online algorithm is to simultaneously minimize the regret with respect to hindsight static optimal benchmark and the total movement cost $M_\cA(T)$ while ensuring feasibility at all times. CONES is an optimization-oriented generalization of the well-known \emph{nested convex body chasing} (NCBC). When the loss function is convex, we propose a lazy-algorithm and show that it achieves $O(T^{1-\beta}), O(T^\beta)$ simultaneous regret and movement cost for any $\beta \in (0,1]$, over a time horizon of $T$. When the loss function is strongly convex, we propose a \textsc{Frugal} algorithm that simultaneously achieves zero regret and a movement cost of $O(\log T)$. To complement t

translated_title: 嵌套演化可行集的凸优化
translated_abstract: 本文考虑了“嵌套演化可行集的凸优化”（CONES）问题，其中目标函数 \(f\) 保持不变，但可行区域随时间演化为一组嵌套序列 \(S_1 \supseteq S_2 \supseteq \cdots \supseteq S_T\)。在线算法的目标是在确保所有时刻可行性的同时，最小化相对于事后静态最优基准的遗憾值和总移动成本 \(M_\cA(T)\)。CONES 是著名的“嵌套凸体追踪”（NCBC）问题的优化导向泛化。当损失函数为凸函数时，我们提出了一种惰性算法，并证明其在时间范围 \(T\) 内，对于任意 \(\beta \in (0,1]\)，可实现 \(O(T^{1-\beta})\) 的遗憾值和 \(O(T^\beta)\) 的移动成本。当损失函数为强凸函数时，我们提出了一种名为 \textsc{Frugal} 的算法，该算法同时实现了零遗憾值和 \(O(\log T)\) 的移动成本。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对嵌套演化可行集凸优化问题的在线算法框架，在凸损失下实现了遗憾值与移动成本的可调权衡，并在强凸损失下同时达到零遗憾和对数级移动成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online algorithmic framework for convex optimization with nested evolving feasible sets, achieving tunable regret-movement trade-offs under convex losses and zero regret with logarithmic movement cost under strong convexity.
